about: What spell_core doesn't have yet of the core's method list (packages/core/spellCore.declarations.json), by the JavaScript name, grouped by why.  Read by tests/test_core_declarations.py, and by the core reference page (guides/targets/core-reference.html).  Take a name out as it's ported.

groups.why: Pauses and events (P11):  Python's runtime hasn't needed these
A browser's only:  a drawable thing's own element (<solitaire-card>), a page's markup, its shadow root
Not decided yet:  a word of Python's own, a browser's only, or ported when a program needs it
